# Upstream compatibility fixtures

These templates and hook readers are copied without semantic changes from
https://github.com/bendusz/deliver at revision
`d9d107ad99d3951499c42d33dcbccb46dcd5f060`, Deliver 0.22.0.
Copyright (c) 2026 bendusz. GPL-3.0-or-later, as provided in the repository LICENSE.

They are test oracles for state/actor compatibility, not a bundled runtime dependency.
Do not alter them to make a compatibility test pass. A future upstream version needs
separate fixtures and an explicit compatibility decision.
